items.source: Callback interface that can be used to customize auto-configured observation registries.
items.translation: 可用于自定义自动配置的observation registries的回调接口。

items.source: T - the registry type to customize
items.translation: T - 要自定义的注册表类型

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
